newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound little changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound little changed against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was little changed against the dollar on Wednesday amid low selling interest, bankers said.
"There are a lot of dollars in the market," said one banker.
Another said he thought it was a sign the market was normalizing again after a scramble for dollars at the end of the financial year on June 30.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar between 3.3885 and 3.3910 bid and between 3.3910 and 3.3925 offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Wednesday was 3.389375 bid and 3.39175 offered. These averages compare to 3.3893 bid and 3.3923 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday 3.389546 to buy and 3.394133 to sell
